about: Stephen C. Willey attended law school and graduated from University of Wisconsin Law School in 1994. Stephen Willey began practicing law in 1994.
Stephen Willey is an attorney at Fennemore, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Fennemore has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Stephen Willey was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
